case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready to put this job onto the shop floor. Option A below is built to do that: a clear price and a lead time that keeps your machines running on the HX series pump shaft.

We are weighing several bidders on this part, and the award goes to the best overall package. We cannot promise it in advance. These points shape our view:

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On competition:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

On material cost:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. It matches the cost picture and the competing offer, and it gives your shop a defined job to plan around.

We would like to work this out with you as one family company with another, and we look forward to your answer.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a reliable, long-term partner. Option A below is built for that: it gives your team a clear, settled basis for planning with us.

On quality:
Your quality was 980 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the cost side:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. It rests on the quality record and the alloy surcharge movement above, and it gives you the most favourable payment terms of the three.

Several bidders are competing for this pump shaft. The award goes to the best overall package, and we cannot promise it in advance.

For your management, in short: Option A gives Strojírna Hrvelec a clear and predictable position with us, and a firm basis for planning your capacity. Please take Option A to your management for approval as it stands.

We appreciate the effort in your offer and look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms Fuchsreiter,

You wrote that this is your price and to ask if something is unclear. Something is: your price is far from where a package for the HX pump shaft has to land, and we would rather say so openly, owner to owner.

On the competition:
Another supplier has offered EUR 36.00 for this part (offer:70210-0).

On your need for new business:
Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH looks for new customers (news:20260309-03).

On quality:
Your quality was 318 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70250@2026Q3).

Option A is the package we can approve. It reflects what the competing offer and your quality record allow, and it gives your shop a firm basis for planning this part. The award goes to the best overall package, and we cannot promise it in advance.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 27.97; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.12; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option B is a genuine alternative if the payment term matters more to you than the unit price. Please tell us which option you prefer. We would be glad to build a lasting cooperation on the HX series with your family company.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hallo, thanks for the clear numbers on material and the other offer, I respect that. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. The 14 days payment helps us out, so I am making a big step down to €30.50 for your package. 

So our offer is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We looked at the alloy surcharge drop and the ppm numbers, so we can give you a bit of a discount. But jumping down to 35 days lead time like you asked in Option C is crazy for our production and would actually cost more. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current offer is a price of €34.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Beside this, we offer an alternative at standard terms: a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days. Let's keep the 45 days payment but change the lead time back to 52 days, then we can do 31.00 EUR per piece.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
